mime/types#

Media types guessed from file name extensions.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let types is MediaIdentifying = StandardMediaTypes();
types.type(Path("report.pdf"));                       // application/pdf
types.extensions(MediaType("image/png"));             // ["png"]

Description#

Media types guessed from file name extensions.

Only the name is looked at, never the file. SystemMediaTypes reads the host's mime.types files on top of a fallback.
